name: aaplug2
description: Get an app you already built with AI onto Google Play and the App Store, or through review, a rejection or a live update. Connect the app once; AA Plug 2 finds review blockers, prepares fixes, store listings (English by default; Korean, Thai, Simplified Chinese or Hindi optional), privacy policy, Data safety and App Privacy answers, content rating, graphics and a step-by-step console guide. You only pick and approve, and nothing is ever submitted without your approval. Works in English (default), Korean, Thai, Chinese and Hindi. Free, no API keys.
